headline: President Clinton issued an order in late 2000 about helping the handoff of power to the next president's administration.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with steps to make the transfer of power from one president to the next go more smoothly. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, offices, or duties it set up cannot be confirmed from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and executive branch officials
who_it_affects.how: They were likely directed to help with the transition to the incoming administration, though the exact duties are not described in the available information.
The order appears aimed at supporting the incoming team as it prepared to take office, but the details are not stated.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 27, 2000; the exact effective date is not stated in the available information.
